name: hashpool
description: Micro-pools de infraestructura: reparto de ganancias de minería auditable on-chain

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace @hashpool/orchestrator && npm run build --workspace web
scripts.test: npm run test:sol && npm run test:ts
scripts.test:sol: npm run foundry && forge test --root contracts -vv
scripts.test:fork: npm run foundry && forge test --root contracts --match-path "test/fork/*" -vv
scripts.build:sol: npm run foundry && forge build --root contracts
scripts.fmt:sol: npm run foundry && forge fmt --root contracts
scripts.coverage:sol: npm run foundry && forge coverage --root contracts --report summary --no-match-path "test/PoolSplitter.invariant.t.sol"
scripts.fixtures:safe: npm run foundry && forge test --root contracts --match-contract SafeTxHashFixture
scripts.fixtures:x402: npm run foundry && forge test --root contracts --match-contract Erc3009Fixture
